description.value: Vanilla Bean Bake Shop is a Parisian-inspired boutique bakery and café in Maple Ridge, self-described as the Ridge Meadows area's first High Tea experience. Founded and operated by a self-taught baker, it offers an extensive menu of cakes, cupcakes, macarons, scones, sandwiches, and espresso drinks made in-house. A touring cyclist would find a welcoming sit-down café environment with both dine-in and takeout options, including a High Tea To Go package.

address.value: 101-11900 Haney Place, Maple Ridge, BC V2X 8T1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and detailed, confirming phone number and URL match OSM.
